Shell(node -e " const fs = require('fs'); const charts = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./src/data/charts.json', 'utf-8')); const csv = fs.readFileSync('./materials/new.csv', 'utf-8').replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''); const lines = csv.trim().split(/\r?\n/).slice(1); // CSVパース（簡易版: クォート対応） function parseCSVLine(line) { const fields = []; let cur = ''; let inQ = false; let i = 0; while (i < line.length) { const ch = line[i]; if (inQ) { if (ch === '\"') { if (i+1 < line.length && line[i+1] === '\"') { cur += '\"'; i += 2; continue; } else { inQ = false; i++; continue; } } else { cur += ch; i++; } } else { if (ch === '\"') { inQ = true; i++; } else if (ch === ',') { fields.push(cur.trim()); cur = ''; i++; } else { cur += ch; i++; } } } fields.push(cur.trim()); return fields; } function norm(v) { return v.replace(/~/g, '～').replace(/\\\\/g, '＼').replace(/,/g, '，'); } // 行をパース const rows = []; for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { const line = lines[i].trim(); if (!line) continue; const parts = parseCSVLine(line); if (parts.length < 4) continue; const score = parseInt(parts[3], 10); if (isNaN(score)) continue; rows.push({ title: norm(parts[0]), difficulty: parts[1].trim().toUpperCase(), level: parts[2].trim(), score, idx: i+2 }); } console.log('CSV行数:', rows.length); // グルーピング const grouped = new Map(); for (const r of rows) { const k = r.title + '_' + r.difficulty + '_' + r.level; if (!grouped.has(k)) grouped.set(k, []); grouped.get(k).push(r); } // マッチング const matched = []; const unmatchedRows = []; for (const chart of charts) { if (!chart.match_config) continue; const mc = chart.match_config; const csvTitle = mc.csv_title ?? chart.title; const key = csvTitle + '_' + mc.csv_difficulty + '_' + mc.csv_level; const list = grouped.get(key); if (!list) continue; if (list.length <= mc.order) continue; const row = list[mc.order]; matched.push({ chart: chart.chart_id, csv: row.title + '/' + row.difficulty + '/' + row.level, score: row.score }); } console.log('マッチ数:', matched.length); // マッチしなかったCSV行 const used = new Set(matched.map(m => m.chart)); const matchedKeys = new Set(); for (const m of matched) { matchedKeys.add(m.chart); } // 各CSV行がマッチに使われたかをチェック const usedRows = new Set(); for (const m of matched) { // 近似: 行内容で判定 usedRows.add(m.csv + '|' + m.score); } const unmatched = rows.filter(r => !usedRows.has((r.title + '/' + r.difficulty + '/' + r.level) + '|' + r.score)); console.log('未マッチCSV行数:', unmatched.length); if (unmatched.length > 0) { const byKey = new Map(); for (const r of unmatched) { const k = r.title + '_' + r.difficulty + '_' + r.level; byKey.set(k, (byKey.get(k)||0)+1); } for (const [k, cnt] of byKey) console.log(' 未マッチ:', k, '(' + cnt + '行)'); } " 2>&1)
